Hanoi University of Science and Technology Admission Scheme 2026. Source: https://ts.hust.edu.vn/

HUST admission methods commonly include direct admission according to Ministry of Education and Training rules, talent admission, admission by thinking skills assessment, and admission by high school graduation exam results.

For IELTS-based admission, an English certificate can be used as evidence for English competence or converted according to the admission scheme when the method allows it. Applicants must satisfy the minimum academic threshold, certificate validity, application deadline, and major-specific conditions.

Computer Science and IT-related programs are competitive, so admission scores and quotas should be checked against the latest official tables and compared across the three most recent years.

# Rmit Vietnam Admission Fees 2026

**Source file:** rmit-vietnam-admission-fees-2026.pdf
**Corpus:** undergraduate admission policies

---

RMIT Vietnam Undergraduate Admission and Fees 2026. Source: https://www.rmit.edu.vn/study-at-rmit

RMIT Vietnam publishes entry requirements, English requirements, tuition fees, scholarships, and program structures for each undergraduate program. Applicants normally need to meet academic entry requirements and English language entry requirements before enro

nd English language entry requirements before enrolment.

For technology-related programs such as Software Engineering or Information Technology, students should check prerequisites, English readiness, semester intakes, program duration, tuition fee per course or per program, and scholarship deadlines.

When comparing RMIT with VinUni or HUST, users should separate admission method, tuition model, scholarship availability, language of instruction, international accreditation, annual intake quota
, international accreditation, annual intake quota, and career outcome evidence.

# Vinuni Admission Scheme 2026

**Source file:** vinuni-admission-scheme-2026.pdf
**Corpus:** undergraduate admission policies

---

VinUni Admission Scheme 2026. Source: https://vinuni.edu.vn/admissions/

VinUniversity uses a holistic admission process for undergraduate programs. Applicants are evaluated through academic records, English proficiency, personal essays, interviews, achievements, and program fit. The Computer Science program belongs to the College of Engineering and Computer Scienc

to the College of Engineering and Computer Science.

Direct admission and priority review may be considered for applicants with SAT, ACT, A-Level, IB Diploma, recognized awards, IELTS Academic, TOEFL iBT, or equivalent tests. A competitive English readiness benchmark is IELTS Academic 6.5 overall or higher, with no band below 6.0, although final yearly requirements must be checked in the official scheme.

Estimated tuition for undergraduate programs is published annually by VinUni. Scholarships

rams is published annually by VinUni. Scholarships and financial aid can significantly reduce payable tuition. Applicants should review yearly tuition, majors, quotas, deadlines, and scholarship conditions.

# HUST benchmark admission scores for Computer Science

**Source:** https://ts.hust.edu.vn/diem-chuan
**Crawled:** 2026-08-04T10:00:00
**Corpus:** undergraduate admission news and score tables

---

The Computer Science and IT groups at Hanoi University of Science and Technology are among the highest scoring programs. A three-year comparison is useful because yearly score movement depends on exam difficulty, quota changes, and applicant demand.

| University | Major | 2023 | 2024 | 2025 | Quota

| University | Major | 2023 | 2024 | 2025 | Quota note |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| HUST | Computer Science | 28.16 | 28.53 | 28.70 | high competition |
| HUST | Data Science and AI | 28.80 | 28.22 | 28.65 | high competition |
| HUST | Cyber Security | 28.05 | 28.32 | 28.50 | limited quota |

Students should treat these as reference values and verify the latest official table before submitting preferences.

# VinUni Computer Science admission and scholarship overview

**Source:** https://vinuni.edu.vn/admissions/computer-science
**Crawled:** 2026-08-04T10:00:00
**Corpus:** undergraduate admission news and score tables

---

VinUni evaluates applicants by academic strength, English readiness, essays, interviews, achievements, and fit with the selected college. For Computer Science, strong mathematics preparation, programming projects, STEM awards, and research activities can strengthen an applicatio

d research activities can strengthen an application.

VinUni publishes tuition and scholarship policies by admission year. Scholarships may reduce tuition for strong applicants. Families comparing VinUni with RMIT should compare total tuition, scholarship probability, curriculum, language of instruction, exchange opportunities, and career support.

# RMIT Vietnam IT admission requirements and tuition

**Source:** https://www.rmit.edu.vn/study-at-rmit/programs/information-technology
**Crawled:** 2026-08-04T10:00:00
**Corpus:** undergraduate admission news and score tables

---

RMIT Vietnam lists academic entry requirements, English requirements, intakes, program duration, tuition fee, and scholarship opportunities for each program. Technology programs may include Information Technology, Software Engineering, Robotics and Mechatronics, and

tware Engineering, Robotics and Mechatronics, and related pathways.

Applicants should check IELTS Academic or equivalent requirements, tuition fee per year or per program, available intakes, and scholarship deadlines. RMIT is often compared with VinUni because both provide English-medium international style education in Vietnam.

# Comparison of tuition, quotas, and admission methods

**Source:** https://admissions.example.edu.vn/compare-fees-quotas
**Crawled:** 2026-08-04T10:00:00
**Corpus:** undergraduate admission news and score tables

---

When users ask to compare universities, the assistant should return a table with university, major, latest benchmark score where available, admission methods, estimated tuition, quota, and notes. Private international universities such as VinUni and RMIT may publish tuition in a d

such as VinUni and RMIT may publish tuition in a different format from public universities such as HUST or HCMUS.

Important comparison dimensions include admission method, direct admission, exam score, competency assessment, portfolio, interview, international certificate, yearly tuition, per-credit tuition, scholarship, financial aid, total program seats, quota by admission method, and source citation.
